title: RV & Boat Storage Collections Timetable and Payment Channels
content:
Accounts receivable keeps one collections timetable for RV & Boat Storage. The late-fee amounts differ by space class; the days are the same in every class.

### Late-fee amounts (USD)

| Space class | First late fee on a month's unpaid rent | Second late fee on a month's unpaid rent | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Open Compact Storage Space | 15.00 | 15.00 | 30.00 |
| Open Standard Storage Space | 15.00 | 15.00 | 30.00 |
| Open Large Storage Space | 20.00 | 20.00 | 30.00 |
| Covered Standard Storage Space | 20.00 | 20.00 | 30.00 |
| Covered Large Storage Space | 25.00 | 25.00 | 30.00 |
| Enclosed Storage Unit | 25.00 | 25.00 | 30.00 |

### Days and conditions (every class)

| Item | Setting |
|---|---|
| Grace period: calendar days after the due day before the first late fee | 5 |
| Day of the month on which the second late fee is charged if that month's rent is still unpaid | the 20th |
| Days after the due day at which gate access is suspended when that month's rent is unpaid | 15 |
| Gate access restored only on payment of the whole past-due balance, fees included | yes |
| Days past due at which the preliminary lien notice is sent | 60 |

### Channels accepted for storage rent and fees (every class)

- automatic ACH (autopay)
- ACH payment through the online resident portal
- card payment through the online resident portal
- money order at the community office
- cashier's check at the community office
- personal check at the community office

### The calendar for one month's rent

With rent due on the 1st (the rate card's due day for every class), the figures above place the points of the month as follows:

| Point | Day reached for a month's rent due on the 1st |
|---|---|
| End of the 5-day grace period | the 6th, five calendar days after the due day |
| Second late-fee day | the 20th |
| 15 days after the due day | the 16th |
| 60 days past due | 60 calendar days after the 1st; the calendar date depends on the lengths of the months crossed |

Reading the amounts: for an Open Large Storage Space the first and the second late fee on a month's rent are each 20.00; for an Enclosed Storage Unit each is 25.00. The returned-payment fee is 30.00 whatever the class.
